capabilities: Conceal text matching user-defined regular expressions
Replace note content dynamically in Live Preview and reading mode
Conceal capture groups from custom regex patterns
extras: The README invites users to share their regex patterns in a community discussion thread.
motivation: The author's main goal is to let users hide ugly, verbose metadata from other plugins that clutters their notes.
problem: Verbose metadata that other plugins add to notes (such as cloze syntax markers) clutters the text while editing and reading.

relations.evidence: Obsidian to Anki utilizes curly braces to signify a line of text that should create a cloze note

summary: Regex-based text concealer that dynamically hides or replaces user-defined text patterns in Live Preview, source mode, and reading mode.
